title: Linked files
removed: The link was removed. The file itself is unchanged.
noConnection: No storage connection is ready for linking. An Admin connects Google Drive or OneDrive and chooses its linking folder in Settings, Integrations.
notSetUpGoogle: Google Drive is not set up on this XOS yet
notSetUpMicrosoft: OneDrive is not set up on this XOS yet
linkingFolderNone: Not chosen yet: document writers cannot link files until you choose one.
linkingFolderHelp: Document writers browse and link only inside this folder of the connected account.

errors.storage_outside_link_folder: Only files inside the folder an Admin chose can be linked.
errors.storage_link_folder_missing: An Admin has not chosen the folder files are linked from. Ask one to choose it in Settings, Integrations.
errors.integration_oauth_state_invalid: This sign-in expired or was started by someone else. Connect again from Settings, Integrations.
errors.integration_oauth_unsupported: This provider connects with a pasted credential, not with a sign-in.
errors.integration_oauth_redirect: The callback address is not valid for this XOS.
errors.integration_account_connected: This account is already connected to another connection of the organization.
errors.integration_not_connected: Link files from a Connected storage connection.
errors.credential_revoked: The provider no longer accepts this connection's sign-in. An Admin reconnects it in Settings, Integrations.
errors.oauth_not_configured: This provider is not set up on this XOS yet.
errors.oauth_refresh_token_missing: The provider granted no refresh token. Connect again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then connect again.
errors.provider_file_missing: The provider no longer has this file.
errors.file_is_folder: Link a file, not a folder.
errors.denied: You cannot link files to this document.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
